description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/vacuous-edit.ts, make two changes.

CHANGE 1 — append this new function at the very end of the file, after the last existing line:

/**
 * A "code only" view for reference counting: comment lines dropped, and string
 * literals blanked ONE LINE AT A TIME.
 *
 * The previous form applied three whole-file regex replaces in sequence. An
 * apostrophe in a prose comment is not a string delimiter, but the first replace
 * treats it as one and pairs it with the next apostrophe anywhere later in the
 * file. On goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts that cut 1,048,462 characters to
 * 519,801, left the remaining quotes unbalanced so the second replace deleted
 * across real code, and ended at 279,328 — 73.4 percent of the file gone, taking
 * all six references to the binding `uf` with it. The gate then reported `uf` as
 * never used and refused a correct repair.
 *
 * Scoping each replace to a single line means a stray apostrophe can corrupt at
 * most its own line, so a mis-paired quote can no longer delete a function.
 */
export function codeOnlyView(source: string): string {
  return source
    .split("\n")
    .filter((l) => !/^\s*(?:\/\/|\*|\/\*)/.test(l))
    .map((l) => l
      .replace(/'(?:[^'\\]|\\.)*'/g, "''")
      .replace(/"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"/g, '""')
      .replace(/`(?:[^`\\]|\\.)*`/g, "``"))
    .join("\n");
}

CHANGE 2 — replace these exact four lines:
  const codeOnly = after
    .replace(/'(?:[^'\\]|\\.)*'/g, "''")
    .replace(/"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"/g, '""')
    .replace(/`(?:[^`\\]|\\.)*`/g, "``");

with this exact single line:
  const codeOnly = codeOnlyView(after);

Do not change anything else. Verified on the real file: after this change the binding `uf` counts 5 references so the gate passes, and the case the stripping was written for still works — a name bound and then used only inside a string literal still counts 1 reference and is still correctly reported unused.
